featured_reviews.name: satyanarayana dash
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to express how truly satisfied I am with this KTM branch and the sincerity of its employees toward customer satisfaction. Honestly, even a 5-star rating feels insufficient for this showroom’s hospitality and their understanding of customer psychology.

Let me share my small story and how these amazing people—Mr. Ashish, Mr. Deepak, Mr. Sagar, Mr. Jaffar, and Mr. Ravi—made my purchase so smooth that the feeling was simply hard to put into words.

I visited the showroom on 03/01/26 on the recommendation of an old friend who had previously purchased a Duke from here. I came with my son to buy the KTM Adventure 390 X Plus after doing a lot of research. At first sight, my 9-year-old son fell in love with the bike—just like his father! He said, “Papa, please buy this one, it looks so cool.” (I currently own a 2012 Classic 350, which he doesn’t really like the look of.)

I approached Mr. Ashish—a perfect gentleman with a calm and reserved style—regarding the price and mentioned one important condition: delivery on 09/01/26, as it was going to be a birthday surprise for my son. He first asked whether I wanted to finance the bike. With a middle-class mindset, I said yes. He then introduced me to Mr. Deepak, who has an excellent understanding of finance. He patiently explained everything about ROI, tenure, and available finance options. Since I am very inquisitive about finance, I asked many questions, but he handled them all calmly and professionally. Finally, I agreed on a suitable finance plan.

I submitted all the required documents on 04/01/26. Honestly, I wasn’t confident that the bike could be delivered within five days, but Mr. Ashish assured me, “Don’t worry sir, we will do our best to deliver on time.”

And today, 09/01/26, I visited the showroom with my wife—and there it was, our new bike, ready for delivery! I also customized the bike with a few additional accessories. Mr. Sagar and Mr. Ravi are truly the best at what they do; they completed everything quickly and perfectly.

The delivery moment and the first ride were simply beyond words.

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Ashish, Mr. Deepak, Mr. Sagar, Mr. Jaffar, and Mr. Ravi for making this experience so special.

P.S.: I hope I have spelled everyone’s names correctly—no mistakes intended!

featured_reviews.name: Tina F Darira
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m writing this review to share a factual experience so others can make an informed decision.

We approached this service centre for an Activa that was not starting (no self start or kick). From day one, the issue remained the same, but each visit resulted in a different diagnosis and additional charges.

Initially, we were told it was a battery issue, then later told the battery was fine and a pipe needed replacement. After paying for that repair, the bike stopped again within 1 km. We were then advised to do a full service, assured that this would fix the problem. We paid again, trusting their expertise.

Within 24 hours, the same issue returned. Only then were we told the battery needed replacement — the same issue mentioned on the very first visit. Till here he had already charged us 2500 rs

Now we go back to him after 10days with the same issue.. this time he told we need to change the battery as that’s the main problem.. but when we questioned the owner he was like no need to change the battery .. u can just charge it …

Despite the bike being kept for over 24 hours multiple times, it was returned without proper testing and even failed to start in front of us. Loose fittings were found again, indicating careless workmanship.

When we questioned this, instead of accountability, the interaction became unprofessional. At one point, the owner stated that if the bike did not fail again, we would have to pay double the amount already paid — despite the issue still not being resolved.

This experience felt less like troubleshooting and more like repeated trial-and-error at the customer’s expense.

I’m sharing this so others are aware and can be cautious.
